response.sql: WITH site_ratios AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(CAST(sm.facetresmm AS REAL) / CAST(sm.geomdeltamm AS REAL)) as site_ratio FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref WHERE sm.facetresmm IS NOT NULL AND sm.geomdeltamm IS NOT NULL AND sm.geomdeltamm != 0 AND s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), status_averages AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(site_ratio) as status_avg_ratio FROM site_ratios GROUP BY insurstat), kept_sites AS (SELECT sr.zoneregistry, sr.insurstat, sr.site_ratio, sa.status_avg_ratio FROM site_ratios sr JOIN status_averages sa ON sr.insurstat = sa.insurstat WHERE sr.site_ratio > sa.status_avg_ratio) SELECT ks.insurstat, AVG(ks.site_ratio) as avg_ratio_kept_sites, COUNT(DISTINCT ks.zoneregistry) as num_kept_sites, AVG(ks.site_ratio - ks.status_avg_ratio) as avg_excess FROM kept_sites ks GROUP BY ks.insurstat
